notes.title: 🛠️ Chamber X - Full Release Update (June 2025)
notes.content:
Updated UI and in-game menu for improved clarity and polish,

Adjusted collision in several hidden rooms for smoother player navigation,

Refined the look of various in-game items to enhance atmosphere,

Increased interaction distance for picking up and reading notes,

Reduced enemy count to 1 for tighter pacing, with updated monster texture and design,

Repositioned some interactable items to improve exploration and flow,

Improved visibility of the first key to help players progress more smoothly
